issues.issue: The budget-form rule says to set review on every line when the column is labelled 'estimated'. All amounts match the page (B29-B56). 12,882.32 + 17,185.31 + 91.89 = 30,159.52, and 30,159.52 + 36,181.94 - 42,485.04 = 23,856.42, the printed line 30. The Documentation of Transfers page (p2) is blank.

This line is 49.6% of receipts. For a cemetery district it is probably lot sales and burial fees (charges for services/fees), plus interest, but the form gives no breakdown, so 'other' with review is defensible.
